## FIXED VERSION -- review before importing

This replaces the old "🔁 Process Each Product" SplitInBatches loop (and everything it drove downstream) with a single "▶️ Process Product (per item)" Execute Sub-workflow node running in "Run once for each item" mode, calling the new **Shopify Merge product sync Pipeline (GraphQL) - Process Product** sub-workflow.

Why: the old nested SplitInBatches setup hit a confirmed n8n platform bug -- live execution data showed it running 289 times but only producing real output twice, silently dropping almost every create/update for the rest of the catalog every run. See the sub-workflow's own README sticky note for the full explanation.

**Import both files, then**: open "▶️ Process Product (per item)" here and pick the sub-workflow from its dropdown (its ID doesn't exist until you import it, so it can't be pre-wired). Nothing else changed -- every other node, mutation, and piece of business logic is untouched, just relocated.

The original file this was built from is left completely unmodified.
